name: Torq of the Sailor’s Friend
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot neck; Price 48,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

The wearer of this shiny copper neck ring, wrought to resemble a series of white-capped waves with a dolphin at each end, is at home on or in the water. For as long as the torq is worn, the wearer cannot become nauseated or sickened when traveling by boat, and receives a +5 bonus to Dexterity-based skill checks associated with movement while aboard a sailing vessel. In addition, the wearer of the torq gains a +10 bonus to Swim checks, and can hold their breath twice as long as normal (4 times their Constitution score).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Item, ocean god’s blessing, sea legs; Cost 24,000 gp.
